snippet.title: Choco Kiosk Simulator | Trailer
snippet.description:
You’ve got $200 and a broken-down kiosk.
Competition, dust, and expired stock — the world is against you.
But you're not here to sniff the candy. You're here for money.

💼 Build your sweet empire from scratch
🧽 Clean shelves, survive police raids
🍫 Sell cookies, chocolates... and something a bit illegal

Wishlist now — and prove you're the king of the corner.
